narrative.northStar: Each class is a boarding pass; the classroom is the gate.
narrative.overview: Students read the app like a departures board: what is boarding now, what is next, am I on it. White passes on a navy tarmac; teacher/admin pages share the navy sidebar, amber active state and navy actions on a light work ground.
keyCharacteristics: Colour is state: amber open, green checked in, red closing/closed, orange late.
Anuphan for glance text, Noto Sans Thai for sentences.
narrative.replaced: Apple-blue system (#0071e3, gray canvas) retired in the Nov 2026 redesign; anti-reference.
